% An \index after a minted listing in the same section, with imakeidx
% and hyperref. With no cache, minted writes no ids for its lines in the
% first LaTeX run, so an index sorted after that run would link ids the page
% does not have. Each number links to the place of its \index, right after
% its listing: after a listing with line numbers and one without, after two
% listings (the second with firstnumber), in italic, sans-serif, and
% typewriter text, in a theorem, and in a subsection's heading. The entries
% after listings' and fancyvrb's listings (delta and epsilon) are guards:
% they linked before.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm,minted,listings,fancyvrb,imakeidx}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\makeindex
\begin{document}

\begin{minted}[linenos]{python}

total = total + 17

total = total + 20
total = total + 21
total = total + 22
total = total + 23
total = total + 24
\end{minted}
